facebookresearch_fairo/perception/fairot.detect_aruco_markers: detect ArUco markers in an image and return their IDs, corners, and estimated poses
facebookresearch_fairo/perception/fairot.estimate_single_marker_pose: estimate the 3D pose of a specific registered ArUco marker from an image
facebookresearch_fairo/perception/fairot.calibrate_camera_charuco: calibrate camera intrinsics using a set of images of a ChArUco board
facebookresearch_fairo/perception/fairot.render_detected_markers: render detected ArUco marker edges, IDs, and 3D axes onto an image
facebookresearch_fairo/perception/fairot.set_camera_intrinsics: set camera intrinsics from a CameraIntrinsics object, a 3x3 matrix, or keyword arguments

facebookresearch_fairo/perception/fairot.create_factor_graph: create a FactorGraph instance to build a pose graph optimization problem with named variables
facebookresearch_fairo/perception/fairot.init_variable_in_graph: initialize a named pose variable in the FactorGraph with an optional Sophus SE3 pose
facebookresearch_fairo/perception/fairot.add_prior_factor: add a prior factor to anchor a named variable to a fixed pose with optional noise
facebookresearch_fairo/perception/fairot.add_observation_between_factor: add a between factor observation linking two named variables with a relative transform and noise
facebookresearch_fairo/perception/fairot.optimize_pose_graph: optimize the FactorGraph using Levenberg-Marquardt and return optimized poses as a Sophus SE3 dictionary

facebookresearch_fairo/perception/fairot.create_scene_with_camera_and_marker: create a Scene object and add a camera and marker to the world frame
facebookresearch_fairo/perception/fairot.add_frame_to_scene: add a new coordinate frame with a given SE3 pose to the scene
facebookresearch_fairo/perception/fairot.update_pose_estimations: estimate relative poses between frames using detected markers and a factor graph
facebookresearch_fairo/perception/fairot.calibrate_extrinsics: calibrate extrinsics between cameras and markers using multiple snapshots and factor graph optimization
facebookresearch_fairo/perception/fairot.visualize_scene: visualize the scene with markers, cameras, and frame axes using SceneViz

facebookresearch_fairo/perception/fairot.convert_so3_to_quaternion: convert a Sophus SO3 rotation to a numpy quaternion array using so3_to_quat
facebookresearch_fairo/perception/fairot.convert_se3_to_xyz_quat: extract xyz position and quaternion from a Sophus SE3 pose using se3_to_xyz_quat
facebookresearch_fairo/perception/fairot.convert_xyz_quat_to_se3: build a Sophus SE3 pose from xyz position and quaternion arrays using xyz_quat_to_se3
facebookresearch_fairo/perception/fairot.convert_sophus_to_gtsam_pose: convert a Sophus pose to a GTSAM Pose3 using sophus2gtsam
facebookresearch_fairo/perception/fairot.convert_intrinsics_to_dict: serialize camera intrinsics to a dictionary using intrinsics2dict and back with dict2intrinsics

facebookresearch_fairo/perception/fairot.create_scene_viz: create a SceneViz instance to initialize a 3D matplotlib figure for visualization
facebookresearch_fairo/perception/fairot.draw_camera_pyramid: draw a camera pyramid at a given pose with configurable size and color
facebookresearch_fairo/perception/fairot.draw_axes_at_pose: draw RGB coordinate axes at a given SE3 pose with a specified length
facebookresearch_fairo/perception/fairot.draw_marker_outline: draw a square marker outline at a given pose with optional ID label
facebookresearch_fairo/perception/fairot.show_3d_scene: render the 3D scene with auto-scaled axis limits and display the plot
